sources.content: The pertwick-cron image runs Pertwick, a cron style job runner for containers. It is built on debian:12-slim and runs as user pertwick with user ID 2001 and group ID 2001. Job files are read from /etc/pertwick/jobs.d, one YAML file per job. The image exposes port 8125 for its status page. The entrypoint is /usr/local/bin/pertwick run. Mount a volume at /var/lib/pertwick to keep the run history database across restarts. The image is published for amd64 and arm64.

Settings. PERTWICK_TZ sets the time zone used to read schedules and defaults to UTC. PERTWICK_MAX_PARALLEL caps how many jobs run at once and defaults to 3. PERTWICK_HISTORY_DAYS controls how long run records are kept and defaults to 14. When a job overruns its next start time, Pertwick skips that start rather than queuing it. A health check calls /healthz on port 8125 every 30 seconds. Set PERTWICK_LOG_FORMAT to json for structured logs; the default is text.

claims.text: The pertwick-cron image runs as user ID 2001.
When a job overruns its next start time, Pertwick queues that start.
